title: Normalized quotient map for the first root line
statement: For every Noetherian scheme T, prime ell invertible on T, and n, the realization of finiteSheaf T ell n 1 maps to quotientLine T ell n 1 with GeneratorCompatible. This concerns only one root factor, with the integral tensor unit inserted on the left.

source.place: Step 2: Existence of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism

proof.text: Use a common compatible primitive-root tower cover. The actual root projection becomes coefficient reduction in its compatible bases, so its scalar extension is an isomorphism normalized on every lifted root.

Identify finite etale roots pulled to the pro-etale site and their scalar realization with the finite root module. Invert the normalized reduction map and insert the integral left unit. Changing bases multiplies both sides by the same unit, hence descent preserves the normalization.

proof_origin.place: Step 2: degree-zero multiplication, first root projection, and tensor induction

lean.statement:
theorem tateTensorQuotient_generator_one
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : (realization T ell n).obj (finiteSheaf T ell n 1) ⟶ quotientLine T ell n 1,
      GeneratorCompatible T ell n 1 f
